# Shoutout Song

> Shoutout Song (shoutoutsong.com) makes custom, personalized songs in about a minute. Enter a name and what the person loves; it writes the lyrics with AI and sings and produces a full track. Free 15-second preview; the full MP3 with a share link is $4.99, no subscription.

- Kids songs: upbeat, family-friendly sing-alongs with the child's name and favorite things (dinosaurs, trucks, unicorns, space, etc.). Voices: boy, girl, child-like.
- Adult and special-occasion songs: birthdays, anniversaries, roasts, retirements, graduations, Mother's Day, Father's Day. Vibes: funny, happy, emotional, hype. 36 genres.
- Songs are original AI-generated works; they don't copy existing songs or use movie/TV characters.

## Main pages
- [Make a song](https://shoutoutsong.com/): the song generator
- [Kids songs](https://shoutoutsong.com/kids-songs): personalized songs for children
- [Song gifts](https://shoutoutsong.com/song-gifts): personalized songs for adults and occasions
- [FAQ](https://shoutoutsong.com/faq): price, timing, genres, previews
